name: release-script-safety
intent: Engineer a local release procedure that proves inputs, ordering, rollback, and noninteractive failure behavior without performing external release effects.
successCondition: Stop when dry-run, repeated-run, interruption, stale-state, and rollback fixtures pass without external mutation.
outputs: dry-run interruption idempotency and rollback evidence
operations: inventory commands effects and implicit state
separate pure preparation from external adapters
add preflight dry-run idempotency and rollback guards
test interrupted repeated and malformed-state paths locally
preconditions: external commands can be stubbed or disabled
the intended artifact and version rules are explicit
positiveTriggers: Harden a release script before any external execution.
Add dry-run idempotency rollback and failure checks to local release automation.
negativeTriggers: Use secrets or mutate remote repositories and registries.
failureModes: stop before the first external effect
leave a typed recovery state after interruption
exclusions: does not push tags packages or deployments
terminationConditions: Stop when dry-run, repeated-run, interruption, stale-state, and rollback fixtures pass without external mutation.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-herald route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
